rounds.text: SJ Corporation Ltd is experiencing explosive top-line acceleration, delivering a compounded sales growth rate of 60% over the trailing twelve months [E8], supported by screens highlighting a staggering sales expansion of 631% year-on-year [E45] and strong overall sales momentum [E46]. This commercial velocity is translating into extraordinary market validation, evidenced by a share price that sits at the absolute peak of its 52-week range [E5] after surging 192% over the past year [E13] and accelerating across three-year (78%), five-year (69%), and ten-year (20%) horizons [E10, E11, E12]. Conceded: [E1], [E2], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E9], [E36].

SJ Corporation Ltd trades at an astronomical P/E ratio of 784x [E1] alongside a price-to-book multiple of 16.16x [E2], demanding a valuation that is completely unanchored from the company's financial reality. This aggressive pricing sits at the absolute peak of the stock's 52-week range [E5], driven purely by a price-led divergence where price growth exceeds profit growth by a staggering 212% [E36]. The underlying operational engine utterly fails to support these lofty expectations, evidenced by a dismal ROCE of 0.1% [E6] and a negative ROE of -0.8% [E7]. Furthermore, despite top-line sales growth of 60% over the trailing twelve months [E8], compounded profit growth has actually contracted by -20% [E9], and the company offers a zero dividend yield to shareholders [E4]. Conceded: compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months is 60% [E8] and compounded share price growth over the past year has surged 192% [E13].

The Bear’s focus on the 784x P/E [E1] and 16.16x P/B [E2] ignores that the valuation is anchored to a massive fundamental shift, evidenced by year-over-year sales growth of 631% [E45]. Sitting at 100% of its 52-week range [E5] reflects accelerating momentum rather than a peak, with share price growth compounding at 192% over the last year [E13] and 78% over the last three years [E12]. Conceded: the recent price growth has outpaced profit growth by 212% [E36], which indicates expectations are running ahead of delivery [E36] following "strong sales growth" [E46] and a 60% compounded sales increase over the trailing twelve months [E8]. The current low ROCE [E6] and ROE [E7] are lagging indicators that do not account for the company's sustained 10-year share price growth of 20% [E10] and 5-year growth of 69% [E11]. While the Bear highlights a trailing profit contraction [E9], the company has actually delivered profit growth exceeding 20% YoY [E48], which is higher than the sector median of 19.8% [E54]. Conceded: the dividend yield is 0.00% [E4].

While the Bull highlights massive sales growth [E45, E8], these figures have failed to translate into operational efficiency, as evidenced by a near-zero ROCE of 0.1% [E6] and a negative ROE of -0.8% [E7]. Conceded: the company has shown year-over-year profit growth exceeding 20% [E48] and the sector median [E54], yet this is undermined by a trailing twelve-month profit contraction of -20% [E9]. The extreme valuation of 784x P/E [E1] and 16.16x P/B [E2] is fundamentally unsupported because the recent momentum is "PRICE-LED" [E36], meaning price growth has outpaced profit growth by 212% [E36]. Finally, the lack of any dividend yield [E4] offers no safety margin for investors paying such a high premium for a business with negative equity returns [E7].
